summary: SMFG filed a Form 6-K disclosing monthly progress of its JPY 180 billion share repurchase program authorized May 13, 2026. During June 1–30, 2026 the company repurchased 12,175,400 common shares for JPY 76.1 billion via market purchases under a discretionary dealing contract. The program covers up to 40 million shares (1.0% of issued) through July 31, 2026. As of June 30 cumulative repurchases totaled 17,614,900 shares for JPY 108.5 billion. No premium, advisor, or special terms apply; this is an open-market buyback return of capital. Watch for completion by July 31 or potential acceleration.
